entities.summary: Huayna Capac, a notable figure in the history of Ecuador, associated with Inca Conquest of Ecuador and Spanish Arrival (1460–1533). Preceded by Inca Conquest of Ecuador and the Kingdom of Quito. Their legacy influenced Atahualpa captured by Pizarro at Cajamarca — November 16, 1532 and Rumiñahui burns Quito rather than surrender to Spanish.
